name: hepi-mono
description: Monorepo for HEPI Pi Coding Agent extensions.

scripts.check: bun run build:aggregates && bun run check:mctx && bun run check:subagents && bun run check:hepi-source && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.base.json && bun run test:hepi
scripts.check:fix: biome check --write AGENTS.md README.md package.json biome.json docs scripts packages/hepi-aft packages/hepi-basics packages/hepi-debug packages/hepi-mono packages/hepi-skills packages/hepi-tools
scripts.check:hepi-source: biome check AGENTS.md README.md package.json biome.json docs scripts packages/hepi-aft packages/hepi-basics packages/hepi-debug packages/hepi-mono packages/hepi-skills packages/hepi-tools
scripts.format: biome format --write AGENTS.md README.md package.json biome.json docs scripts packages/hepi-aft packages/hepi-basics packages/hepi-debug packages/hepi-mono packages/hepi-skills packages/hepi-tools
scripts.format:check: biome format AGENTS.md README.md package.json biome.json docs scripts packages/hepi-aft packages/hepi-basics packages/hepi-debug packages/hepi-mono packages/hepi-skills packages/hepi-tools
scripts.lint: biome lint AGENTS.md README.md package.json biome.json docs scripts packages/hepi-aft packages/hepi-basics packages/hepi-debug packages/hepi-mono packages/hepi-skills packages/hepi-tools
scripts.build:aft-pi: bun install --cwd third_party/aft --no-save && bun run --cwd third_party/aft/packages/pi-plugin build
scripts.build:magic-context: bun install --cwd packages/hepi-mctx --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd packages/hepi-mctx build
scripts.build:subagents: bun install --cwd packages/hepi-subagents --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd packages/hepi-subagents build
scripts.build:aggregates: bun run build:aft-pi && bun run build:magic-context && bun run build:subagents && bun scripts/build-aggregate.mjs --all
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/hepi-aft/dist packages/hepi-basics/dist packages/hepi-mctx/packages/pi-plugin/dist packages/hepi-subagents/dist packages/hepi-tools/dist packages/hepi-skills/dist packages/hepi-mono/dist
scripts.check:mctx: bun install --cwd packages/hepi-mctx --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd packages/hepi-mctx check
scripts.check:subagents: bun install --cwd packages/hepi-subagents --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd packages/hepi-subagents check
scripts.pack:check: bun install --cwd packages/hepi-mctx --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd packages/hepi-subagents --frozen-lockfile && bun scripts/verify-packages.mjs
scripts.test: bun run build:aggregates && bun run test:hepi
scripts.test:hepi: bun test --max-concurrency=1 --path-ignore-patterns='third_party/**' --path-ignore-patterns='packages/hepi-mctx/**' --path-ignore-patterns='packages/hepi-subagents/**' --path-ignore-patterns='packages/hepi-basics/test/tui-replay.test.ts' --path-ignore-patterns='packages/hepi-tools/test/ask/component.test.ts' --path-ignore-patterns='packages/hepi-basics/test/ui/render.test.ts' && bun test packages/hepi-basics/test/tui-replay.test.ts && bun test packages/hepi-tools/test/ask/component.test.ts && bun test packages/hepi-basics/test/ui/render.test.ts
